title: A Timeline of Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Relationship
summary: Here's everything that has gone down between the Grammy-winning pop star and the Kansas City Chiefs tight end.
contentText:
Travis Kelce must have taken some notes from Taylor Swift ‘s Midnights track “Mastermind,” because after just two months of shooting his shot with the multi-Grammy-winning superstar, the “Anti-Hero” singer was spotted cheering on the Kansas City Chiefs tight end at one of his football games in September 2023. Talk about manifestation!

Fans have been loving the unexpected pairing ever since, with Swifties christening the couple “Tayvis” and, at one point, starting a hilarious trend on TikTok of telling their male partners that Swift put Kelce “on the map.” And while the coupling between Swift and Kelce might seem random to the casual entertainment consumer, Billboard is here to help trace back how the two titans of their very different industries have come together and fallen in love over the course of many headline-making months. Below, we’ve compiled a full timeline of all the most notable moments in their relationship, from the football player trying to give a friendship bracelet to Swift during her July 2023 Eras Tour stop in Kansas City to all of their football game outings, concert appearances and mushy-gushy interview moments talking about their relationship that have happened ever since.

So if you’ve managed to escape the barrage of news coverage and social media discourse on Swift and Kelce’s relationship and need to catch up on how one of the most high-profile couples of the decade came to be — or you just want to relive the high points of their all-American romance — there’s no need to look any further.
